steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content:
Chief, this Sinner is very dangerous.
I'll be standing outside during the interrogation and check in once every fifteen minutes.

options: No need. I'll take care of myself.
I appreciate it, but it shouldn't take over fifteen minutes.

choices.text: No need. I'll take care of myself.
I appreciate it, but it shouldn't take over fifteen minutes.

steps.content: Nightingale is trying to hold back on saying something, which piques your curiosity.
What kind of person will you be meeting that could make your adjutant so worried?
(Clank)
As you enter the interrogation room, you hear the sound of metal clanking.
Your interrogation target, Chameleon, is sitting on the chair playing with a gold-plated pocket watch.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: To be that wary of me... Miss Nightingale really is a competent and loyal adjutant!
The sentence is obviously a compliment, but somehow it sounds sarcastic.
I'm sure you know our time is limited, so let's cut to the chase.
test
test
test
test
test
test
What is your relationship with the <color=#e45515>Jacknal family</color>? Why did you hypnotize them without their consent?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Come on, you believe hypnotizing someone is a crime, Chief?
She scans the sheet of paper containing the accusations against her, but shows no signs of admitting her guilt.

According to the records, the four people you had hypnotized experienced different degrees of auditory hallucinations.
They've even attempted suicide several times due to their mental disorder...
Is it not a crime to cause substantial and irreparable harm to others for your own purposes?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Then what about the mental connection induced by the shackles you put on Sinners? Is it not a crime?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: What is the difference between my so-called unconsented hypnosis and your unconsented connection to someone's spiritual world?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: We are the same. We invade someone else's subconscious without consent and give pain.

options: I'm not in the mood to argue with you.

choices.text: I'm not in the mood to argue with you.

steps.content: The spiritual connection is a side effect of the shackles. It's not intentional.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Oh, is that so?
(Clank)
She continues playing with her pocket watch, sizing you up with interest in the sound of crisp metal clanking.
The side effects caused by shackles are passive, whereas you are actively hypnotizing. What exactly is your purpose?
(Clank)
The clanking of the pocket watch interrupts your question.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Well, what about the interrogation?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Isn't the interrogation where you goad Sinners and make them remember their painful past, Chief?

options: The interrogation is to find out about your crimes.
You should stop changing the topic.

choices.text: The interrogation is to find out about your crimes.
You should stop changing the topic.

steps.content: I know what I'm doing. Mind your own business, Sinner.
Neither spiritual connection nor the reasonableness of interrogation should be the subject of our discussion today.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: So Chief, you're not denying that interrogations serve to make Sinners face the painful truth?
It must be done to preserve the law and order of the DisCity.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content:
Even if you know that these truths will hurt them...
Even if you know many Sinners are not actually evil.
At the very least, they did not develop mental problems after the interrogation like the Jacknal family.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content:
Is that so? Then what about the dreams you saw?
Were they really not hurt as a result of your interrogation?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I'm sure you know better than I do, Chief, that the interrogation room is very oppressive...
Chameleon scans the room filled with monitoring equipment and sighs.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Can they really see you as a "friend" to fight along with after walking out of this place?
Chameleon looks at you with rare sadness in her eyes as if she really were worried about your situation.

options: Why are you discussing this with me?

choices.text: Why are you discussing this with me?

steps.content: Do you have something painful that you don't want me to reveal? Or is it that...
...It will bring you some advantages if I were to feel shaken up and guilty about the interrogation and spiritual connection?
We've talked for so long but you haven't revealed anything about your crime.
On the contrary, you've been trying to trap me into wavering from the connection and interrogation.
What exactly do you want?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hahahaha...
The resentful woman from a second ago drops her disguise in the blink of an eye and laughs out loud.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You're smart, Chief. But not smart enough.
(Clank)
The pocket watch in her hand opens and closes again. But this time, the sound is especially piercing and almost disorient you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief!
Nightingale's voice clears up your head quickly.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Time is up. Let's suspend the interrogation.
Fifteen minutes already? Time is passing much faster than expected.
That will be it for today. Next time, I will not give you a chance to dodge the questions.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Uh-huh, go ahead.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No, it is too dangerous to be in the same room with a Sinner that can hypnotize!
Nightingale's attitude is uncharacteristically tough.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Don't make it hard for Miss Nightingale. She is just worried about your safety!
Is Chameleon's tone pleasant because she is happy to have escaped the interrogation? Somehow, her smile makes you feel something is off.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ouch! Watch where you're going!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh, it's you, Chief! You've been chanting something like "How should I deal with Chameleon" this whole time and didn't even look where you're going. Are you getting stupid from the interrogation?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So how was your dog training this time? Did she cry and beg you, "Stop it, I'll tell you everything!"

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: The Chief has a lot to deal with every day. You can't blame the Chief for bumping into others.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: And it feels improper to call that "dog training"...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Let me change a word then. What about slave training?
I have never treated you like dogs or slaves.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? You sure you haven't?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You have.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I think everything the Chief has done fits the definition of what slave owners do to their slaves.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Governing us, restricting our freedom, commanding us to battle, and even connecting to us spiritually to make us confess about our past...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sounds even more outrageous than slave owners. I'm surprised you could say it with a straight face.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't see anything wrong with that.
We've gone through so much, so we should be considered friends at least. I've also never forced you to do anything against your will.

steps.speaker: Ariel
steps.content: You... haven't?
Ariel's voice trembles, clearly avoiding your gaze. She moves back a few steps with fear.
It reminds you of Chameleon's words.
Were they really not hurt as a result of your interrogation?
I did not force you to show your scars. The interrogation was part of my duty...

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hahahahah, you say that to just anyone, don't you?
Why are you suddenly talking about this? Did someone leak the content of the interrogation just now?

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Hahahahah, do you still not want to admit what you've done?
The three who were talking to you suddenly turn into Wendy wielding a chainsaw, letting out shrill laughter.

steps.speaker: Wendy
steps.content: Do you believe that the Sinners should thank you? That everyone who died in my memories should thank you? Hahahahah!
When did you get here...?

steps.speaker: Pacassi
steps.content: There's nothing you can do... Tragedy has already struck.
The people in front of you are making instantaneous changes. This is not normal at all! You start to feel a dizzying headache.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: You're just curious about what we're hiding. Don't make it so glorious.

steps.speaker: Demon
steps.content: You want to pry into our suffering.
That's not true.

steps.speaker: Ninety-Nine
steps.content: Are you proud to see us being tortured by your shackles?
I never had such intention.
You try to calm yourself down, but your brain is a mess.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Actually, I had no choice but to cooperate with the interrogation...

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Obnoxious bastard, stop being a hypocrite.

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: A friend? I cannot afford a friend like you.
The Sinners' constant criticism is a nightmare.
Wait, a nightmare...?
You seem to have figured out what's going on.
(Clank)
You hear the familiar clanking sound of metal again.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hmm, you woke up a little later than expected.
Chameleon is still sitting in the interrogation room, playing with the pocket watch in her hand.

options: When did you start hypnotizing me?
Why did you show me that?

choices.text: When did you start hypnotizing me?
Why did you show me that?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Heheh, ever since Nightingale interrupted the interrogation. It was all mirage.
Was it to avoid the interrogation?
If you don't want to answer case-related questions, you can remain silent. But it is unethical to hypnotize others without their consent.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Aha, relax. I just wanted to see how confident you are towards interrogations and mental connections.
There's no point in doing this. It is my duty and obligation to interrogate Sinners about their past and sort out their crimes.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hahahahah, if you were that determined, how come I was able to hypnotize you?
You...
You are unable to retort. The pain of being rejected, questioned, and alienated by the Sinners under hypnosis still haunts you.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Actually, apart from prying into others' pain, we share one more crime, that is, exploiting others' trust.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You build trust with Sinners to extract information. Similarly, hypnosis requires gaining the patient's trust.
I've never believed a single word you said.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That's not important... Isn't absolute suspicion just another kind of trust?
She does not seem to plan on explaining her words, only looking at you condescendingly.
This arrogance once again makes you realize the "danger" that Nightingale warned.
It looks like coercive measures are necessary.
A dark red glow covers and wraps around Chameleon. She shows no signs of resistance and does not even take a glance down at the changes.
After controlling your ability, I have many ways to make you talk. Are you not afraid?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: And are you not afraid of me, Chief? Someone who has been hypnotized once will surely have a second and a third time...
I'm not going to let you get away with it again.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hold that back for now, Chief. Hypnosis can be a useful psychotherapeutic tool, especially when you want to forget or remember something...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I don't need it.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content:
Heheh, who knows?
If there's something you feel you've forgotten, feel free to come to me for advice.

options: Call Nightingale and end the interrogation

choices.text: Call Nightingale and end the interrogation

steps.content: Nightingale, put Chameleon into solitary confinement, confiscate her pocket watch, and have guards watching her on regular shifts.
Until she confesses the motive for her crimes, do not let anyone get near her!

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Looks like you don't want to pay attention to me anymore... Are you mad because you're so ashamed?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Relax, we're the same. We've both been in pain and brought pain to others.
She leans in close to your ear.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: But in these chaotic times, pain... may not be a bad thing.
Your unease does not subside until Chameleon is taken away by the guards.
Is her lack of honesty in the interrogation room just a means to avoid confessing the truth?
"Pain may not be a bad thing." Perhaps this is the only true thing she said today.
